Name: Crab Pot Bait Recolor
Author: Riazaia
Description:
[size=3]The tiniest of mods! Seriously. Changed a grand total of 21 pixels to make all of our lives infinitely easier. Also, the color of the bait now matches the actual in-game bait item so that's nice, right? Comes in two versions in case you still find the bait hard to see inside the pots and need to strap a chunk of bug meat to the handle. Just... don't think too hard about it okay? 

[/size][color=#ffd966][size=2][b]Note:[/b] simply making the bait more pink does make it more visible but it keep in mind it's more difficult to see when underwater. Handle chunky thingy is the way to go if you're like me and want to know at a glance, as soon as you step into a map,  which of your crab pots are baited and which aren't. YMMV :D[/size][/color]
[size=3]
This mod uses [/size][b]Content Patcher[/b][size=3] to change the appearance of baited crab pots. Nothing else has been changed! [/size]
[size=3]I'd love to hear any thoughts, comments or suggestions. I hope you like it![/size]

[b][size=4]How to Install[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. Install [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[size=3]2. Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[size=3]3. Download, unzip and put inside Mods folder
4. Enjoy![/size]

Downloads.Description: Updated to the latest Content Patcher version. Make sure to delete the previous mod folder (it used to be called [CP] CrabPot Fix I believe)
